text: The presence of a systolic ejection click suggests associated valvular pathology, likely a bicuspid aortic valve, which is commonly found with coarctation. I will request an echocardiogram to visualize the aortic arch and confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram

text: RESULTS: Narrowing of the aorta distal to the left subclavian artery with a gradient, consistent with coarctation. Left ventricular function is normal.
